faq.q: What is the origin of Naci?
faq.a: Naci is associated with Arabic. Naci is the Turkish form of Arabic نَاجِي (Nājī), the active participle of نَجَا, meaning 'survivor, saved'.
Yes — the underlying form نَاجِي is Arabic.
Naci can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Naci should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Nājī is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Naci, naci. Script forms are ناجي, ناجی, نَاجِي, नाजी.
